summary: Vision Marine Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its common shares will commence trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on May 1, 2026, while maintaining its Nasdaq listing. The filing also discloses activity under an existing at-the-market equity program, with 1,055,333 shares issued at a weighted average price of US$1.95 per share for gross proceeds of US$2,060,250. The TSX listing aims to expand Canadian investor access as part of the company's capital markets strategy. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved.
